mlb.joint_season_hr_sb_distribution.measurement_fix: Given current HR_0, SB_0, team games remaining G, per-game play probability from availability and PA per game by lineup slot, set rates r_HR and r_SB per PA = (ROS projection * 250 + season pace * n)/(250 + n) with n = season PA. Output P(HR_0 + HR_rest >= H* and SB_0 + SB_rest >= S*) for contract thresholds. As-of: daily.
